recipe.visualDefinition: A central, towering fist rising from a base of intertwined human figures, set against a vibrant blue sky with a glowing yellow sunburst behind the hand. The arm and fist are composed of brown, earthy tones, suggesting a tree-like or organic structure made of people.
coreVisualRelationships: The fist acts as the primary vertical axis, anchoring the composition.
The sunburst creates a halo effect, providing a high-contrast focal point behind the knuckles.
The base of the arm transitions from a mass of small human bodies into a solid anatomical hand.
coreInvariants: Earthy brown subject against a cyan-blue background
Metaphorical fusion of human bodies and a giant hand
Soft, painterly texture with visible brushwork

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central vertical subject occupying 80% of the height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The clenched fist at the top third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the base of human figures, travel up the 'trunk' of the arm to the fist, and rest on the glowing sun.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive blue sky surrounding the central figure provides breathing room and emphasizes scale.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sky; high value contrast between the dark fist and the bright sun.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy browns, sky blues, and sun yellows

characterSpecificRedesigns: Forward slash used as a thin separator between phrases

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in a black header bar above the artwork

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for all metadata and titles to maintain a clean, modernist look against the complex art.
graphicDevices: Black horizontal border at the top for text placement

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the 1970s geometric aesthetic and tight spacing.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and clean lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an oil painting of a giant brown fist rising vertically from a mound of small, intertwined human figures. The fist is centered. Behind the fist is a glowing yellow sunburst. The background is a solid, slightly textured cyan-blue sky. The style is 1970s surrealist illustration.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a black horizontal bar at the very top. Place white geometric sans-serif text centered in the bar with tight tracking. Use a thin forward slash to separate the two main title elements.

verificationChecks: Is the fist composed of human figures at the base?
Is there a glowing sunburst behind the hand?
Is the text contained within a black header bar?
Is the color palette restricted to blue, brown, and yellow?

adjustableVariables: Density of human figures in the arm
Shade of blue in the sky
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos in the corners
Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the hand looks like a fist, not a tree.
Check that the transition from figures to solid hand is smooth.
Verify the text is legible and tightly spaced.
Confirm the sunburst does not overpower the silhouette of the hand.
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist central metaphor + organic human-based structure + high-contrast sky/sun background + minimalist geometric header typography.
